content.text: Everyone, take a look at my old running shoes. The wear is quite severe. Should I replace them?
@Big Liu, it looks like you have severe overpronation and may need better support.
@DaLiu If you're thinking about changing shoes, you might consider this luxury brand collaboration. The price is quite high-end.
@Ricky Shoes aren't important. Check out my classic pair—even with holes, I can run happily.
@Iron Sister, but different color schemes can affect the overall feel. I'm still struggling with the color issue.
@Coach Zhang I tried on a few pairs at the physical store, but they were too tight.
@Big Liu, next time you try on shoes, remember to check the space at the toe to make sure it's not too tight.
@Big Liu, why not try the one I recommended? It should offer a better comfort experience.
@Ricky I still think signature sneakers from star players are more appealing.
@Xiao Pi I just bought new running socks, and they match really well.
@Peach As long as the soles are durable enough, everything else is not a problem.
@Iron Sister, I bought a pair on sale, the price was just right.
@Big Liu I just received the newly arrived top-tier racing shoes, and the experience is fantastic.
Everyone, remember to tie your shoelaces properly to avoid foot discomfort.
@Coach Zhang, you said I overpronate? But looking at the wear on my old shoes, it seems like supination?
@Big Liu, looking at Figure 1, it really looks more like an outward flip. Maybe I was mistaken before.
Look at my shoe wall, it's practically an art exhibition.
@Ricky You're such a sneakerhead. Unfortunately, I think the wall of shoes is not as important as the feel on the feet.
Which color do you think makes the skin look fairer?
@Peach I think the color on the left is brighter and makes the skin look fairer.
This is the midsole technology of my new shoes, check out this carbon plate.
@Ricky It's indeed high-end and can significantly enhance running performance.
@Peach I think the color on the right is more stain-resistant and suitable for long-term wear.
@Peach It's best to try the color in person, as photos might have color discrepancies.
@Ricky Your shoes are packed with technology, but I still prefer the feel of star player signature editions.
Probably still need to go to the store to see the actual effect.
@Big Liu, pay attention to your foot shape issues; choosing the right shoes is very important.
I'll keep an eye on the shoe styles. The discounted pair I bought before was quite comfortable.
These shoes are a bit tight. What do you all think?
@Big Liu Can the toe of the shoe be pressed to create a gap?
There is still no gap after pressing.
@Big Liu If it's a bit tight, long-distance running might be uncomfortable.
I still think luxury brands offer better comfort.
@Big Liu It's important to choose the right one; don't force it.
@Big Liu, try different sizes or styles, you'll definitely find the right one.
Finally chose the discounted item, payment successful.
The discounted items also offer quite a good value for money.
I'm still torn between these two colors. Which one do you think makes the skin look fairer?
@Peach I think the color on the right makes the skin look fairer.
@Peach It depends on the color of the clothes you pair it with.
@Peach The color on the left looks more suitable for summer.
@Peach, you should still choose the color you like. It's important to wear something that makes you happy.
Check out these top-tier racing shoes I just unboxed—the design is absolutely stunning.
@Ricky These shoes look really cool, and it feels like they could boost speed a lot while running.
No matter how good the shoes are, they must be comfortable to run in. @Ricky, are you sure they're comfortable enough?
@Iron Sister, these shoes feature the latest midsole technology, so comfort is definitely not an issue.
I have a display case here with sneakers signed by star players. What do you think?
@Xiao Pi Wow, these shoes are all worth collecting! But I'm still struggling with the color of the running shoes.
@Peach Color is indeed very important. You might try choosing some neutral tones, which could make your skin appear brighter.
@Peach I think you should choose the color you like, so you'll be more motivated to run.
This is a picture of my newly bought running socks, the colors are quite bright.
@Peach When running, choosing bright colors will make you more visible.
@Everyone I've been using this repair glue to fix worn-out soles.
@Iron Sister, your repair method is quite interesting, but I think new-tech running shoes might be more suitable for Da Liu.
@Iron Sister, your repair glue reminds me of my sock matching issue.
@Ricky I think Liu should consider comfort, especially when trying on shoes.
@Everyone The correct way to tie shoelaces is important, especially for running gear.
@Coach Zhang It seems I need to learn the correct way to tie shoelaces.
@Big Liu Sometimes simple repairs are more meaningful than replacing with new ones.
@Big Liu I'm still torn about the color issue, hoping to find a pair of running shoes that make my skin look fairer.
@Peach I think bright colors might make you look fairer.
@Peach, try different combinations, and you might be pleasantly surprised.
@Peach Color is just superficial; comfort is what truly matters.
@Peach Don't worry too much about the color; just find what suits you best.
@Big Liu Thank you for everyone's suggestions. I will consider them carefully.

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 在讨论大刘的旧跑鞋是否需要更换时，张教头指出可能有内旋过度的问题。Ricky推荐价格高昂的奢侈品牌跑鞋，而铁姐则认为鞋不重要，重点是跑得开心。大刘最终购买了打折款，Ricky则展示了自己新购的顶级竞速鞋。对话中有人提到颜色搭配和鞋带系法。
(第2段摘要): 大刘发现自己旧鞋磨损像外翻而非内旋过度，Ricky展示了他的鞋墙和新科技跑鞋，桃子纠结于选择显白的跑鞋颜色。
(第3段摘要): 大刘最终选择了打折款跑鞋并成功付款。桃子仍在纠结跑鞋颜色的选择。
(第4段摘要): Ricky展示了他的顶级竞速鞋，小皮展示了签名战靴，桃子仍然纠结于跑鞋颜色，并展示了新买的跑步袜搭配图。大家给出了各自的建议，但桃子仍需考虑。
(第5段摘要): 本段对话围绕大刘是否更换跑鞋展开，铁姐推荐修补胶水，而张教头展示了正确系鞋带的方法。桃子仍在纠结跑鞋颜色搭配问题。
resolved_events: 大刘决定购买打折款跑鞋
